summary: VF Music: listen-first open-license audio discovery with author/license provenance and verified-before-save; full-track failed-source skip; pinned SHA384-SRI hls.js Chrome HLS decoding; real browser playback truth and bounded same-station radio failover; Cantonese, Mandarin and nostalgia-first radio discovery. Existing guarded management actions and deep links remain. No new Schema/Auth/Updater permissions or Production changes.
